requirements.name: Payment provider transaction gateway integration
requirements.summary: The system must securely connect with external financial institutions to process customer payments and initiate fund transfers.

requirements.name: External logistics network status synchronization
requirements.summary: The system must ingest real-time data from third-party logistics providers to monitor fleet availability and route constraints.

requirements.name: Third-party fraud detection service consumption
requirements.summary: The system must query external risk engines to validate customer identities and assess transaction fraud likelihood.

requirements.name: Regulatory authority compliance data ingestion
requirements.summary: The system must retrieve and validate external regulatory licenses and food safety certifications for store partners.

requirements.name: External mapping service geospatial integration
requirements.summary: The system must consume live traffic and road network data from external mapping vendors to calculate accurate delivery times.

requirements.name: Payment provider refund and reversal interface
requirements.summary: The system must enable seamless communication with external payment gateways to process refunds and handle failed transactions.

requirements.name: External courier API delivery proof retrieval
requirements.summary: The system must integrate with third-party courier APIs to automatically fetch digital proof of delivery evidence.

requirements.name: Third-party tax calculation service connection
requirements.summary: The system must interface with external tax authorities or services to dynamically compute and remit applicable sales taxes.
